title: 4 Common Reasons Your Tap Won't Stop Dripping
description: A dripping tap is more than an annoying sound—it can waste hundreds of litres of water each month. The most frequent culprit is a worn-out rubber washer or degraded O-ring inside the handle assembly, which loses its watertight seal over time. In modern single-lever mixer taps, a damaged or mineral-encrusted ceramic disc cartridge is usually responsible. Corrosion on the valve seat or excessively high household water pressure can also force water past intact seals. Replacing worn internal components early prevents damage to sink surfaces and keeps water bills under control. If replacing the washer doesn't fix the drip, a professional can test your pressure and replace the internal cartridge.
